Which day? You know where — place, which. Here's the which part on its own. It rises.
Which day? Day, which, question ending.
The days of the week. Each one starts with the word day, then its name. Two halves, like the numbers. Monday.
The name is jan — flat. Tuesday. Two long, level syllables after day.
Wednesday. The name is one short syllable, sitting high.
Thursday. The longest one — three quick syllables. Say the end of it first.
Use them. Are you free Monday? The day goes first.

Saturday. The name rises — like a question.
Sunday. Two syllables after day, and the last one is short and high. Say the end of it.
